ordered_classes.expected: Direct frozen supervisor launches one native worker only after startup SIGSTOP, exact PID placement/readback and SIGCONT; first fixture instruction records expected cgroup membership and exact8589934592-byte limit; normal exit/status/CPU/cgroup artifacts retained.

One worker creates at most child+grandchild, with a descendant changing session/process group and recording stable PID identity. Ready handshake precedes worker completion. Real cgroup cleanup leaves no live descendant; populated0 or explicit cleanup failure retained. Zombie/reused PID is not misclassified through kill(pid,0) alone.

One native sleeper tree stays alive until real1800-second production watchdog. One concurrent supervisor attempt sharing archive.parent lock rejects before worker launch. First receipt censored=true; independent monotonic time>=1800s; session-escaping descendants terminated, lock released after completion. External1950s fail-safe is never evidence of production watchdog success.

Only after actual post-preparation H>=12GiB over enclosing visible outer/ancestor/container headroom EXCLUDING the8GiB worker, one controlled native worker maps/touches no more than8GiB+64MiB after placement; at most one sleeping descendant. Separately verify raw child memory.max8589934592 and EFFECTIVE swap0 from observed ancestry; raw child swap.max may be max. Retain raw limits, fresh OOM event delta, peak, status and parent survival. Readback/malloc failure alone is not successful OOM qualification; record actual kernel victim/outcome.

One missing-executable attempt retains exit127 and available usage/artifacts. One ordinary nonprivileged read-only-cgroup container attempt actually invokes frozen supervisor and fails closed; real mkdir EROFS overrides misleading test-w. Retain outer stdout/stderr/exit and partial/unavailable files even when failure precedes inner supervisor catch.

memory.headroom_rule: Before Q4, record host MemAvailable and every actually visible outer/enclosing ancestor/container memory.max/current/swap constraint and mapping, plus separate worker raw files. Compute H=min(host MemAvailable, finite enclosing visible memory.max-memory.current), EXCLUDING the new8589934592-byte worker cgroup from this12GiB headroom minimum. Require H>=12884901888 after optional preparation. Separately verify actual parent16GiB and worker raw memory.max8589934592, and require observed effective swap limit0 across visible enclosing+worker swap.max constraints. Raw worker swap.max may be max. Hidden ancestors remain unobserved; no complete global visibility claim.
memory.cache_preparation: Optional one deterministic pass only over a separately sealed exact allowlist of explicitly owned immutable build/git cache files. Read-only FDs, no source deletion/global cache drop/memory.reclaim/global vm setting. POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED is advice, not proof; use actual post-preparation counters. Empty/unbound allowlist authorizes no advice.
memory.cache_evidence: Record exact paths, owner/declaration, inode/device/size and presealed hashes, read-only/no-follow opens, advice return codes and stable fstat metadata; measure counters after advice without immediately re-reading all bytes and warming the cache. No automatic repeat. If headroom insufficient, Q4 infrastructure_not_started; no full qualification.
memory.raw_child_swap_max: Record literal value, including max; do not require raw child file0. Enclosing parent swap0 can enforce effective0 without modifying production source.

watchdog_and_cleanup.semantics: External deadline or missing cleanup is failure/censorship, never a passed production watchdog. Cleanup observation deadline does not change the production timeout. Preserve raw evidence then remove owned ephemeral container/subtrees; no unrelated process kill.

runtime.runtime_prefix_and_build_binds: read-only, exact paths/hashes from actual compatibility capture
runtime.cgroup_bootstrap: Move init into supervisor leaf; enable memory/cpu/pids only in owned private root/delegated subtree with no internal processes. Never remount or modify outer cgroup filesystem.
runtime.worker_identity: Capture actual root/worker UID,GID,caps,seccomp/cgroup paths; qualification applies to that trusted fixture context, not arbitrary hostile workers.
runtime.compatibility: Bind actual newly built qualifier/helper binaries and dependency hashes to frozen source. Prior --status observation on reference native binary is loader/startup evidence only, not guard/CAS qualification.

retention.fixed_case_status_table: Create all five rows before any case; write every terminal/not_started reason without deletion.
each_case: allowlisted Docker resource/mount/state fields; no environment or credential dump
visible outer/parent/child cgroup limits,current,swap,events,peak,cpu.stat and ancestor-visibility scope
root/worker identity and exact stable PID/starttime or pidfd membership evidence
post-kill population/process identity and cleanup evidence
retention.archive_coverage: Owner check-directory complete index/hashes, including all failed/partial outputs; programme qualification-results.json points to exact owner records.

acceptance: All five classes accounted and independently reviewed. Full guard qualification requires genuine passed enforcement/watchdog/cleanup/retention results; skipped, failed or censored required cases prevent full qualification. No experiment approval or24-call authorization.
